svg.title: Throughput by workload
svg.desc: and: sift 12,646, sift (positions off) 11,942, Elasticsearch 5,674, pg_search 2,421, pg_textsearch 80, rum 2,502, pgx-bm25 91; or: sift 3,823, sift (positions off) 3,960, Elasticsearch 4,077, pg_search 1,700, pg_textsearch 4,301, rum 27, pgx-bm25 77; phrase: sift 10,727, sift (positions off) 3,046, Elasticsearch 7,682, pg_search 2,232, pg_textsearch 101, rum 85, pgx-bm25 56; mixed: sift 6,911, sift (positions off) 4,663, Elasticsearch 5,831, pg_search 2,067, pg_textsearch 88, rum 49, pgx-bm25 66; count(*): sift 14,113, sift (positions off) 3,545, Elasticsearch 12,384, pg_search 2,176, pg_textsearch 86, rum 100, pgx-bm25 57; filter: sift 5,645, sift (positions off) 5,032, Elasticsearch 5,226, pg_search 1,934, pg_textsearch 91, rum 50, pgx-bm25 57; join: sift 3,048, sift (positions off) 1,930, Elasticsearch 5,622, pg_search 465, pg_textsearch 107, rum 53, pgx-bm25 63
svg.text: queries per second, higher is better
Error bars: one standard error over the interleaved rounds (rough for 2-3); red: relative error above 10%.
Elasticsearch: a JVM server over HTTP; its join is a term filter on a denormalized region field.
Simple English Wikipedia, 50,000 articles, 8 clients, median of 2-3 rounds; AMD Ryzen 7 9700X, 16 threads (load avg 4-7); Oct 2026.
